known: Published aggregate conclusions, methods and author plotting code have been read. Only table schemas, row identifiers, feature-availability counts and source selection labels have been inspected; individual functional outcome values remain unexamined.
source: Nature Methods 2026 doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03069-y; author repository 9ef726695ee84aed3627c517e8eb1097bae73df2; GSE304702 structure and GSE303560 post-thiolutin RNA measurements
translation_gate: Verify culture matching before any TE analysis. The author code labels the external 37C TE condition as 37C plus serum. Do not treat it as temperature-only validation of the structure experiment.
decay_candidate: Evaluate whether the deposited 204-row 3UTR integration table and full RNA time-course table support a held-out test of structural homogeneity beyond simple reactivity, Gini, GC, length and initial abundance.
permitted_next_reads: Identifiers, source metadata, structural feature columns, their missingness and condition mapping; inspect RNA-table headers and count whether required timepoint/replicate cells are present without printing or modeling their values.
endpoint_scope: Relative RNA persistence after thiolutin, not an absolute decay constant. Source StepMiner step labels must not be relabeled exponential half-lives. No causal structure or synonymous-intervention claim.
eligibility: At least 60 independent gene groups with compatible 30C structure and two RNA biological replicates at 0 and 120 minutes; at least 25 groups in each genotype/sequence-family-separated development and validation partition. Verify how the structure cohort was selected and whether RNA outcomes entered selection.
features: Source homogeneity is a read-profile statistic; it is not automatically an inferred structural occupancy, base-pair probability, or thermodynamic ensemble entropy. Require its exact definition and the meaning of replicate 0 before analysis.
quarantine: RPS19A and RPL29 are published selected reporter examples and cannot serve as new independent validation.
if_eligible: Freeze a separate outcome protocol, all model choices and partitions before accessing RNA endpoint values.
if_ineligible: Record the specific absent evidence and keep outcomes unopened. Do not lower the independent-unit threshold or silently replace the endpoint.
